name: Dock scheduler
design: Average adult male with cream-tan spotted hide, long tapered cranium and thin mandibles, long dreadlocks swept over one shoulder. Dark wrap tunic with asymmetric long left hem, bronze rectangular breast badge without writing, narrow satchel strap, high soft collar. One hand studies a small square slate at chest height, other hand lowered holding two small seal tags. Straight tidy posture.
